description: "Seven Discourses on Art" by Sir Joshua Reynolds is a collection of inaugural addresses delivered at the Royal Academy in the late 18th century. This work provides foundational principles of art as articulated by Reynolds, a prominent painter and the Academy's first president, encapsulating the blend of theoretical knowledge and practical application vital for artists seeking excellence.
